policy: MIT / Apache-2.0 only. Dev-time tooling; nothing from here ships into a production build. Attribution (upstream + item URL) is recorded per swap in .tryon/journal.json.

refusals.reason: AGPL-3.0 (repo renamed to cosscom/coss) — verified via GitHub API 2026-09-24
MIT + Commons Clause (source-available, not OSI MIT)
repo and registry endpoints 404 as of 2026-09-24

registries.name: shadcn/ui
registries.notes: Flat /r/<name>.json is GONE (404) — item URLs are style-scoped. Style comes from the target project's components.json (default base-nova). New items import cn from the real npm package `cn` (@^0.4.0) — do not rewrite that import.

registries.name: SmoothUI
registries.notes: Installs under components/smoothui/<name>/index.tsx; pulls registry deps (e.g. smooth-button) and can add many CSS variables to app/globals.css.

registries.name: Magic UI
registries.notes: Mostly effect primitives (marquee, particles, animated lists); some need framer-motion/motion.

registries.name: KokonutUI
registries.notes: Items are registry:component (they land under components/, not components/ui/).

registries.name: basecn
registries.notes: shadcn primitives ported to Base UI — the right source for a Base-UI project alongside shadcn base-nova.

registries.name: Tailark
registries.blocked_note: registry:block items are paywalled (401 'Sign in with a plan that includes blocks') — index them but mark NOT free.
registries.collision_warning: some items own lib/utils.ts — exclude any item whose files target aliases.utils/aliases.lib
registries.notes: Radix and Base UI support; ui/lib only for us.

registries.name: Efferd
registries.notes: LICENSE title line is malformed (GitHub reports NOASSERTION). Do not index until a human confirms MIT.

registries.name: Cult UI
registries.notes: registry endpoint returns 429 (Vercel bot challenge) from a plain fetch AND from the shadcn CLI — not installable as-is. Index from the GitHub mirror only if we later self-host a mirror.
